title: When the Scholarship Wakes
author: Sable Thackeray
blurb: Silas Okafor, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
